scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Sharp One-Third Stability of Brenier Maps” (preprints/Sharp-One-Third-Stability-of-Brenier-Maps-September-25-2026/article.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 374 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 e9821deea8e836aa), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every K, Y as above there is a finite constant C(K, Y ) such that ∥Tµ − Tν∥L2(ρ) ≤ C(K, Y ) W2(µ, ν)1/3 µ, ν ∈ Prob(Y )  . The targets may be atomic, singular, or absolutely continuous. The exponent 1/3 cannot be replaced by any larger exponent in general, even for K = Y = [−1, 1]d and targets with exactly three atoms.
